title: Websites and apps you can access with NHS login
text:
# Websites and apps you can access with NHS login

## NHS services

- National Booking Service - provides systems that enable people to book appointments across England.

- NHS App - a secure way to access a range of NHS services on your smartphone or tablet.

- NHS England Digital Weight Management Programme - supports adults living with obesity who also have a diagnosis of diabetes, hypertension or both, to manage their weight and improve their health.

- e-Referral Service (e-RS) - a way for patients to choose their first hospital or clinic appointment with a specialist.

- Register with a GP surgery - register with GP surgery or change your current GP surgery online.

- Yellow Card scheme - report safety concerns around any healthcare product (provided by the Medicines & Healthcare products Regulatory Agency)

## Other digital health and care services

You can also use your NHS login to access lots of other digital health and care services that are commissioned by the NHS.

## Health and wellbeing

These services allow you access your health records to track and improve your health and wellbeing:

- Cognitant ( Healthinote )

- Inhealthcare ( Inhealthcare )

- MyWay Digital Health ( MyWay Diabetes )

- Orb ( Orb app )

- Shaping Cloud ( GM Digital Platform )
